title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1558: Great deceit king (2)

section.p: “Die!”

Su Yu and Old Wan moved together without a need to communicate with each other. The two attacked with great precision and zero hesitation. The six reacted by attacking, but the two did not even bother to block any of their incoming attacks. They only focused on attacking.

This was indeed a fight to the death. Old Wan’s river suddenly snapped, interrupting the first enforcer elder momentarily. Taking that chance, Su Yu threw a punch with all his strength, allowing all the attacks sent his way to land on him.

Since he had promised to kill the first enforcer elder, he naturally needed to keep his promise. As a middle-degree Eternal, the first enforcer elder had done nothing but spew nonsense out of his mouth. Su Yu was determined to risk injury just to kill the elder.
The elder felt like cursing.
Damn it!
Madman!
Did the two not want to keep living? What was this?
“Kill them!”

He wailed in desperation. The two lunatics were without any additional lives. Meanwhile, the heads of the West Spire and South Chamber were both late-stage Eternals. Why were Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng ignoring their attacks?

Were they really mad? Yes. They must be completely mad. He started fleeing. He couldn’t even flee riding his River of Time as it had snapped alongside Old Wan’s river. He didn’t even hesitate as he knew what would come after the removal of his river.

He did not intend to be the sacrifice to the lives of the two lunatics. They would never survive this. Why should he die with them? The first enforcer elder kept cursing inwardly as he fled. Just then, Su Yu’s fist arrived.

The first enforcer elder blanked out. Why was he so fast? Did nobody try to stop him? Suddenly, the West Spire head’s sword turned around to strike the palm of the South Chamber head. Originally, Su Yu was the recipient of that palm attack.
The West Spire head was supposed to be targeting Wan Tiansheng, but he had switched his target at the last moment, allowing Su Yu to throw his punch at the fleeing elder without any interruption.
The first enforcer elder’s body crumbled as he roared with fury, “You traitor!”
“Traitor?”

The West Spire head replied indifferently, “No, I’m not. The Heavenly Overseer Marquis is the traitor here. The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion belongs to Culture King’s line. And Culture King’s line belongs to humanity. Who is the traitor here?”
The South Chamber head drew a sword and said, “West Spire, don’t forget that a hundred thousand years have passed since the ancient past.”
The West Spire head replied, “I am aware of that. But that doesn’t change anything. The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion belongs to humanity.”
Instantly, the two top experts clashed, filling the sky with the projections of their swords even as space shattered around them.

Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng were both surprised to see that. They had been prepared to kill the first enforcer elder at the risk of their lives. In fact, Su Yu was already prepared to open the death tunnel and flee into the Death Realm with his heavy injuries after the kill.
But the same thing happened again.
Someone had stepped forth to help humanity yet again.
Su Yu was left quite speechless. He had lost count of pro-humanity heads in the pavilion. The heads of the West Spire, Heaven, Profound, and Yellow Departments were all pro-human.

Just how did the Heavenly Overseer Marquis come to trust these people? Did he believe that they had all been brainwashed by him? But would a human cease being a human so easily? Before long, a River of Time appeared and a new first enforcer elder emerged.
But before Su Yu could attack, the other Invincibles arrived. The heads of the North Chamber, Earth Department, and Profound Department shouted together, “Those outside! Join us!”
Damn it!
The West Spire head had turned against them!
Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.

The scholar did not appear surprised. He merely sighed with regret. Sure enough, life and death, race, and faith were not things that could change easily. No matter what, Culture King was the true master of the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.

Some of the old fossils were aware of this. Some humans also loved infiltrating the pavilion. or to be precise, it didn’t matter if one knew. Generation after generation, numerous humans had joined the pavilion.

During the first six epochs, the pavilion had not dared to kill these humans. They had accepted these humans for fear of retribution. The scholar was aware that both the West Spire and Heaven Department heads were humans. But they were humans from the first six epochs.
Even after so long, the West Spire head had still defected. The West Spire head had betrayed him. Their loyalty toward the Culture King was still stronger. The scholar wasn’t surprised.
In fact, this deployment was a form of test. The scholar could only admit that he had overestimated his charm and underestimated their loyalty toward their own.
Step by step, he walked out of the main hall.
A golden page floated above his palm.
It was time for him to make a move. It was time for a cleansing in the pavilion. There were simply too many humans in their ranks. Since he had picked a side, this was unavoidable.
At the same time.

In his stone statue form, the old turtle shifted his body slightly. Then, he transformed into his human form outside the city. He looked down at the city before looking up at Su Yu. After thinking about it, he laughed.
Could Su Yu do it?
Probably.
But he was quite confident in Su Yu. The kid should be able to take on his burden for a bit, even if his burden was excessively heavy. Unfortunately, he had to remove his city.
That was the only way he could fight the Heavenly Overseer Marquis. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be a match since the Heavenly Overseer Marquis was equipped with the Heavenly Supervising Catalog.

At that thought, the city transformed into a golden robe. Yes. His weapon was not offensive in nature. It was a defensive weapon. During the ancient past, the grand dream turtles were known for their defensive prowess that was comparable to the 72-Forged Iron Devourer of the iron devourers.

And the golden robe, with its 144 golden stripes, was a powerful defensive weapon meant to strengthen his defense. A smile appeared on the old turtle’s face. He wasn’t too good in a fight, but the Heavenly Overseer Marquis would need to get through his turtle shell before talking about anything else. After ripping a portal in the air, the old turtle stepped through it.
At the same time, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis paused slightly. Then, he strode forth. Outside, a delicate youth was waiting. He asked, “Brother Grand Dream, are you here to stop me?”
The old turtle smiled, “You jest, Marquis. I have to do something. After all, that is a mayor of the holy cities.”
“Spirit Suppression General, the Devote King once offered you the title of a marquis. Why did you refuse the title?”

The old turtle said, “That’s merely a rumor. You can’t trust rumors. There is some truth to it, but it’s not entirely accurate. The Devote King said that I would need to watch the tunnel on the seventh level after my advancement. I gave up since that job was too difficult.”
The Heavenly Overseer Marquis chucked, “I see.”
“Shall we start, Brother?”
“Let’s.”

The two smiled courteously before ripping space apart and stepping into the void. They did not start fighting immediately. Rather, both vanished right after stepping into the boundless void. Two rays of light could be seen shooting far away.

With each step, the two seemed to have returned to the past. With another step, they moved to the future. Behind them, corpses dropped. A larger number of the corpses had the appearance of the Heavenly Overseer Marquis, while a smaller number of the corpses had the appearance of the old turtle.

When the Heavenly Overseer Marquis pulled out his Heavenly Supervising Catalog, the old turtle was starting to find it difficult to continue advancing. He sighed and said, “Is it proper to use a belonging of the Culture King against humanity and me?”
“I have no other choice.”

“True. It’s too late for you to turn back. It’s but a mere weapon. Must you really make it yours? But not even that is a big deal. The Culture King might forgive you for that. And he is most likely dead. Why would Su Yu make life difficult for you because of this?”
“I don’t have the courage to bet on them. I am unwilling to hand my fate in the hands of others. Please understand me, Brother Grand Dream.”
“I understand. But it’s never yours. You’re also not enough to handle me. I might not be that good at fighting, but you won’t be that much better at it than me…”
As the two conversed nonchalantly, corpses continued piling behind him.
More and more of them were appearing.

Countless old turtles died. Countless Heavenly Overseer Marquises died. With each step they took, some would die. A short while later, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis groaned as blood dripped down his mouth. He looked at the old turtle bitterly and said, “I…You are indeed as strong as a marquis. You are very good at hiding your strength, Brother Grand Dream.”

“You’re too kind.” The old turtle said, “But this is mostly because the Heavenly Supervising Catalog is not yours. You wasted too much of your strength on it, to the point you’re now weaker than me. Heavenly Overseer Marquis, just give up.”
“That is not possible.”
In such a manner, the two continued conversing while strolling like old friends, a trail of corpses behind them.
Immortal Realm.

The look in Tiangu’s eyes shifted. Suddenly, a coffin appeared and shot toward Su Yu. The old turtle was kept busy by the Heavenly Overseer Marquis. The old turtle was the one Tiangu had been wary of all along. That turtle was simply too old.
At the same time, the old turtle sighed and tossed a turtle shell out to block the coffin. He said, “Tiangu, don’t bother with these tricks. If you can break my shell, I’ll allow you to kill Su Yu.”
Tiangu had an unsightly expression, but he said nothing. Right at that moment, a chant sounded and spread across the Myriad Realms.
Suddenly, Su Yu coughed a mouthful of blood. He felt as though his head was about to burst apart.
Something seemed to be attacking his sea of willpower. Fortunately, the Culture Tomb had slowed the attack slightly, giving the golden book the chance to defeat the invading dark energy.

Wan Tiansheng’s expression changed drastically. His refined smile faded, replaced by an expression of boundless fury as he roared, “Bastard! Shameless! As a Pseudo Emperor, why are you ambushing a mere Cloudbreach?”
A figure had appeared far in the horizon.
A figure shrouded in darkness.
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor.
Yes. He had mounted a sneak attack against Su Yu earlier.
The Pseudo Emperor clicked his tongue and said, “What a good treasure. Su Yu, you are indeed blessed by luck.”
Just as the old turtle and Tiangu acted, he had moved as well. He was very powerful. He was also the sole Daofuse the celestial chasm race had produced after the collapse of the ancient past.

However, his curse had been stopped by Su Yu. It was unbelievable. A powerful treasure must be at work there. He was certain that there was a supreme treasure on Su Yu. It might even be a divine weapon. After all, that attack of his couldn’t be stopped by even a peak heaven weapon.
Everyone present was shocked. Such an effort just to kill Su Yu. A hunt of Su Yu by the myriad races.
The Divine Pseudo Emperor, Immortal Pseudo Emperor, Nether Pseudo Emperor, Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor, and Heavenly Overseer Marquis had acted. Five Daofuses. Just to kill Su Yu.

The Devil Pseudo Emperor would have acted as well if it weren’t for the recent loss of his tri-life bodies. There were also three Daofuses fighting on Su Yu’s fight. Additionally, there were more than ten ninth-degree Eternals in the fight as well. This was probably the biggest battle in the history of the tenth epoch. Too many top experts were involved.
